title: 119 The phenomenon of urban crimes is an important feature in metropolitan cities but the pattern varies from city to city. 2.3.2 India is predominantly a rural country as only 25.7 per cent of its population lives in urban areas (as per 1991 census) while majority of the population(74.3%) lives in rural areas. Of the total Urban population (2,171.8 lakhs), nearly one-third (769.9 lakhs) constituting 35.44 per cent live in 23 metropolitan cities (one million plus population). The proportion of metropolitan cities population to the national population is 8.7 per cent. There is no demarcation between rural and urban areas as far as the crime statistics are concerned since these were not collected on this basis, but as the crimes in urban areas are peculiar and have shown a consistent rise parallel to the population increase, during the previous few decades, it has generated interest to make a study of the crime phenomenon. An attempt has been made to highlight the prevalence of some crimes in the Urban areas. For the sake of analysis of crime situation in these areas we have confined ourselves with the available data of above mentioned 23 Metropolitan Cities only.
